gloss.Solid-State: Solid electrolyte instead of liquid — higher energy density and safety
gloss.LFP: Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4) — cobalt-free cathode; long life, lower cost
gloss.NMC / NCA: Nickel Manganese Cobalt / Nickel Cobalt Aluminium — high-energy cathode chemistries
gloss.Sodium-ion: Uses sodium instead of lithium — cheaper, abundant materials
gloss.Silicon Anode: Silicon replaces graphite in the anode for higher capacity
gloss.Lithium-Metal: Pure lithium-metal anode — next-generation energy density
gloss.Graphene: Carbon nanomaterial used for electrodes and conductivity
gloss.Supercapacitor: Stores charge electrostatically — very fast charge/discharge
gloss.Cathode: The positive electrode of a battery cell
gloss.Anode / Graphite: The negative electrode of a cell, typically graphite
gloss.Electrolyte: The medium that carries lithium ions between electrodes
gloss.Separator: Membrane keeping electrodes apart while letting ions pass
gloss.Alt. Chemistry: Beyond Li-ion: flow, zinc, iron-air and other chemistries
